name: Sebas' assistant
start: Hi! I'm Sebas' virtual assistant. I can tell you about his data and automation services, the keychain and case shop, his projects and how to contact him. What are you interested in?

fallback.a: I'm not sure I understood. I can help with services, prices, projects or contact. If you prefer, message Sebas directly and he'll reply.

entries.a: The Games tab has 20 games made by Sebas: mobile arcade games (the Boss Duel, a 1930s cartoon-style boss fight; Cubehead —a 3D runner with the music “Final Boss Pursuit”—, Bolt Runner, 3D Layers, Orbit, Data Snake, sensor-based Ball Bearing, Akazu Dance, Screw Inspector) and interview-style mental agility exercises (math, ink vs. word, logic series, memory, N-back, Tower of Hanoi, sliding puzzle, 1-A-2-B trail, impulse control and mental rotation). The Interview Challenge ends with your profile: a radar chart, analysis and practice plan, and you can copy or download it.
Sebas has a YouTube channel, Akazu IA: an artificial intelligence avatar that turns trends, dances, viral audios and memes into short videos. He can also create AI content for your brand.
Besides regular 3D parts, there are glow-in-the-dark pieces, three-color pieces, chess pieces and articulated skeleton keychains. Tell Sebas which one you like.

b.wa: Hi, I'd like a special 3D piece

entries.a: Hi! How can I help? Ask me about services, prices, projects or contact.

Sebas offers:
• Data engineering and ETL
• Automation with n8n and AI chatbots
• AI content for social media
• PLC programming and industrial automation
• Custom products (printed keychains and cases) and 3D printing

b.wa: Hi, I'd like a quote for a service

entries.a: Reference prices in COP: keychains from 8,000, aluminum cases from 35,000 and glass cases from 40,000. 3D printing and data or automation services are quoted per project. Confirm your quote on WhatsApp.
Keychains are printed with your photo, name or logo on an aluminum sheet. Vivid colors and very durable. From COP 8,000.
There are phone cases printed in full color on aluminum (from COP 35,000, glossy finish) and on glass (from COP 40,000, mirror effect and deep color).

b.wa: Hi, I'd like a custom phone case

entries.a: Prototypes, spare parts, figures and functional parts are 3D printed in 1.75 mm PLA with a Dremel DigiLab 3D20. Maximum size: 230 × 150 × 140 mm. Tell Sebas your idea to get a quote.

b.wa: Hi, I'd like a quote for a 3D part

entries.a: Sebas connects WhatsApp, Google Sheets, CRM, email and stores in automated n8n workflows, plus API integrations, automatic reports and data synchronization.

Sebas builds AI chatbots for support, scheduling and customer follow-up 24/7, connected to n8n workflows. As a technical advisor he implemented one that extracts, validates and routes reports to the responsible areas.

b.wa: Hi, I'd like a chatbot for my business

entries.a: Images, short videos, copy and content calendars are created with AI for social media, including automated posting with n8n.
In industrial engineering Sebas develops, modifies and debugs PLC and HMI programs and supports the automation and upgrade of processes and lines.
Sebas combines Machine Learning, Cloud (AWS) and AI. He designs medallion-architecture ETL pipelines, works with SQL, Python and R, and builds predictive models, dashboards and web applications.

Juan Sebastián Sánchez Urbano (Sebas) is an industrial automation engineer and digital solutions developer, focused on Machine Learning, AWS and AI. He is the founder of JS Soluciones and has experience in plant processes and technical sales. He lives in Cali, Colombia.
The Projects tab has data, automation, web and engineering work, each with a link to see it.
You can message Sebas on WhatsApp or leave your details and message in the form. He replies with information and a quote.

b.wa: Hi, I'd like a quote for a service

entries.a: Sebas is based in Cali, Colombia. To arrange deliveries or shipping of products, message him on WhatsApp.
